提携・決済・暗号資産
銀行・融資の取りまとめ

relations.text: 個人ローンの証券化(3.75億ドル)を、BlackRockの運用ファンド・口座のみに販売(2023年10月30日、SoFi発表)
relations.text_en: Placed a $375M personal loan securitization exclusively with funds and accounts managed by BlackRock investment advisors (October 30, 2023, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2023年10月30日)
source.quote: today announced an agreement to place a $375 million personal loan securitization exclusively with funds and accounts managed by BlackRock (NYSE: BLK) investment advisors.
source.note: 2023年の単発の取引で、相手はBlackRockが運用するファンドです。
source.note_en: A one-off 2023 transaction with BlackRock-managed funds.

relations.text: Blue Owlが運用するファンドと、最大50億ドル・2年間の個人ローン事業(Loan Platform Business)契約を確定(2025年3月13日、SoFi発表)
relations.text_en: Finalized an up to $5B two-year Loan Platform Business agreement for personal loans with funds managed by Blue Owl Capital (March 13, 2025, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2025年3月13日)
source.quote: SoFi Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SOFI) finalized an up to $5 billion Loan Platform Business agreement for personal loans with funds managed by Blue Owl Capital
source.note: 相手はBlue Owlが運用するファンドで、期間は2025年3月からの2年間です。
source.note_en: The counterparty is funds managed by Blue Owl; two-year term from March 2025.

relations.text: 2024年第4四半期に、5.25億ドルの個人ローン証券化をPGIM Fixed Incomeが運用するファンド・口座と実施(2025年1月16日、SoFi発表)
relations.text_en: Closed a $525M personal loan securitization in Q4 2024 with funds and accounts managed by PGIM Fixed Income (January 16, 2025, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2025年1月16日)
source.quote: a $525 million personal loan securitization agreement closed in Q4 2024 with funds and accounts managed by PGIM Fixed Income
source.note: 相手はPrudential傘下のPGIM Fixed Incomeです。
source.note_en: The counterparty is PGIM Fixed Income, an asset manager within Prudential Financial.

relations.text: Mastercardと提携を強化し、SoFiのステーブルコインSoFiUSDをMastercardの世界の決済網での決済手段にできるようにする(2026年3月3日、SoFi発表)
relations.text_en: Announced an enhanced partnership with Mastercard to enable its SoFiUSD stablecoin as a settlement option across Mastercard’s global payments network (March 3, 2026, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年3月3日)
source.quote: SoFi Technologies, Inc. today announced an enhanced partnership with Mastercard to enable SoFiUSD as a settlement option across Mastercard’s global payments network.

relations.text: 法人向けの法定通貨・暗号資産バンキング「SoFi Big Business Banking」の最初の参加企業としてMastercardが挙げられている(2026年4月2日、SoFi発表)
relations.text_en: Mastercard is named as an initial participant in SoFi Big Business Banking, SoFi’s fiat and crypto banking offering for enterprise partners (April 2, 2026, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年4月2日)
source.quote: Initial participants will include Cumberland, Bullish, BitGo, B2C2, Fireblocks, Wintermute, Galaxy, Jupiter, Mesh Payments, and Mastercard.
source.note: 開始時の参加企業の一覧で、参加条件の詳細は書かれていません。
source.note_en: An initial-participant list at launch; participation terms are not detailed.

relations.text_en: Galaxy is named as an initial participant in SoFi Big Business Banking (April 2, 2026, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年4月2日)
source.quote: Initial participants will include Cumberland, Bullish, BitGo, B2C2, Fireblocks, Wintermute, Galaxy, Jupiter, Mesh Payments, and Mastercard.
source.note: 開始時の参加企業の一覧です。「Galaxy」はGalaxy Digitalと解釈しています。
source.note_en: An initial-participant list; “Galaxy” is read as Galaxy Digital.

relations.text: Templum経由で、SoFiの会員がStepStone Private Markets Fundを利用できるようにした(2024年12月4日、SoFi発表)
relations.text_en: SoFi gave members access to the StepStone Private Markets Fund through its relationship with Templum (December 4, 2024, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2024年12月4日)
source.quote: announced access to three new private market funds through a relationship with Templum
source.note: 利用はTemplum(未上場)のプラットフォーム経由で、SoFiの直接の取引相手はStepStoneとは限りません。
source.note_en: Access is via the Templum (private) platform; SoFi’s direct counterparty is not necessarily StepStone.

relations.text: Goldman Sachs Bank USAが、SoFiの改定済み回転与信契約の管理代理人(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs Bank USA is administrative agent under SoFi’s amended and restated revolving credit agreement (FY2025 10-K)

source.label: SoFi 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the issuing banks party thereto and Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as administrative agent.
source.note: 相手は子会社のGoldman Sachs Bank USAです。
source.note_en: The counterparty is the subsidiary Goldman Sachs Bank USA.

relations.text: SoFiの6.976億ドルの個人ローン証券化で、組成代理人・共同主幹事を務めた(2025年3月3日、SoFi発表)
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs was structuring agent and joint lead bookrunner on SoFi’s $697.6M personal loan securitization (March 3, 2025, SoFi release)

source.label: SoFi の発表(2025年3月3日)
source.quote: Goldman Sachs was the structuring agent and joint lead bookrunner with Bank of America.
